agents.name: Requirements agent

agents.name: Test data agent

agents.name: Automation agent
agents.produces: Self-contained Playwright specs that load their test data

agents.name: Execution agent
agents.produces: Real Playwright run results with evidence

agents.name: Defect agent
agents.produces: Defects raised only from real failures

agents.name: Reporting agent

platform.capability: Guest hotel booking from search to confirmation (AQPI-1)

testing.name: EQE testing
testing.focus: The guest's business flows across the six services (search, hotel details, offers, cart, payment, reservation, confirmation and cancellation e-mails), plus the privacy, security, observability and resilience checks (AQPI-28 to AQPI-31).
testing.approach: Keeps the journeys already in the baseline, re-designs the ones whose flow changed, adds journeys for new flows, then runs the business flows on the new build.

selection.name: EQE testing
selection.focus: The guest's business flows across the six services (search, hotel details, offers, cart, payment, reservation, confirmation and cancellation e-mails), plus the privacy, security, observability and resilience checks (AQPI-28 to AQPI-31).
selection.approach: Keeps the journeys already in the baseline, re-designs the ones whose flow changed, adds journeys for new flows, then runs the business flows on the new build.

gaps.message: The hotel services have no browser screen, so the journeys run through the service APIs; screen checks such as keyboard and focus order stay manual.

skills.name: Automation script conventions
skills.description: How every generated Playwright spec is shaped, named and asserted, so scripts stay reviewable and runnable cycle after cycle.

skills.name: Test cycle report
skills.description: The fixed shape of every cycle report, so two cycles can be read side by side without translation.

skills.name: Defect reporting
skills.description: What a defect must contain before it is raised, so every cycle's defects read the same and are actionable.

skills.name: Incremental load and merge rules
skills.description: How an addition is classified against the baseline and what a human must see before it merges.

skills.name: Input normalisation and provenance
skills.description: How several inputs become one requirement set, and what must be visible about where each statement came from.

skills.name: Input review before the human gate
skills.description: What the review agent checks in the project inputs and how it words its suggestions for the reviewer.

skills.name: Release criteria (Go / Conditional go / No-go)
skills.description: The parameters the cycle report applies to recommend Go, Conditional go or No-go. Edit this file, or upload a replacement, to change them without a code change.

skills.name: Test case authoring and Zephyr export shape
skills.description: One house style for every test case, so each cycle exports into Zephyr the same way.

skills.name: Test data generation from the input specs
skills.description: Every test case gets a complete, spec-conformant data set built from the data dictionary in the codebase input.

skills.name: EQE testing - enterprise end-to-end business flows
skills.description: Steers the agents to test each business flow end to end across the services, as the user experiences it.

skills.name: Traceability hand-over
skills.description: What each phase owes the next one so the chain from input to defect never breaks in any cycle.

rows.text: A guest can complete the complete search-to-confirmation flow using valid inputs.
Only bookable inventory and valid rates are presented as available.
Total price is disclosed before confirmation, including mandatory taxes and fees.
Ancillary offers do not block booking when declined or unavailable.
The platform prevents or safely handles duplicate reservation submissions.
A successful reservation produces a durable confirmation identifier.
Confirmation is displayed on screen and an email request is generated.
Required business and technical events are logged using approved identifiers and masking rules.

The Product Owner has accepted the capability end to end.
Given valid search criteria, when the guest submits the search, then a search request is created and matching available hotels are returned.
The submitted criteria remain visible and editable on the results page.

narrative.text: Hotel booking release 2.0 (AQPI-32 + AQPI-23) · EQE (incremental) worked from Jira epic AQPI-32, AQPI-23 (Jira export on GitHub), Codebase sri465inno/uc-agentic-quality-engineering@demo/hotel-booking-platform-v2 (e0dab1c) (pulled live from GitHub). The reviewed requirement set holds 138 requirements (20 unchanged · 3 enhanced · 20 new). 18 test cases are designed, 13 of them automated in 12 Playwright scripts. Execution ran 13 automated cases for real: 13 passed and 0 failed (pass rate 100%). No defects were raised.

Execution: 13 automated cases really executed by Playwright 1.63.0 (headless Chromium, JSON reporter) against Hotel booking platform release 2.0, six Spring Boot services built from branch demo/hotel-booking-platform-v2 (demo/hotel-booking-platform-v2); 5 manual case(s) designed but not executed.

No model was used (no model API key set): normalisation, review, design, data, triage and prose are rule-based. Delta classification, coverage, pass/fail and defect raising are always computed in code.
